facts.value: Accepts exactly DownBoundU, DownWaitU, DownDamageU, DownBoundD, DownWaitD, or DownDamageD when x2224_b2 is set or dmg.x1838_percentTemp < p_ftCommonData->x428. Acceptance calls ftCo_8009F184 and returns true; rejection returns false. The flag bypasses the comparison, whose equality and unordered cases fail. No grounded guard appears. True reports admission/setup, not guaranteed final DownDamage motion.
facts.rationale: Preserve exact guards while correcting the downstream final-state overclaim.

evidence.why: Shared callee can override requested motion.

facts.value: Requests DownDamageU only for incoming DownWaitU and DownDamageD otherwise. Calls ftCo_8008DCE0(gobj, requested_motion, fp->facing_dir), then ftCommon_8007E2F4(fp, 1), without a local rejection path. The request is not an unconditional final motion: shared setup can replace it with literal 0x5A when kb_level_base >= 2 and the damage element is Ice.
facts.rationale: Separate local selection from actual shared-callee final motion without assigning gameplay meaning to a numeric literal.

facts.value: When x2224_b2 is clear, subtracts one from float mv.co.downdamage.x0 before returning if animation frames remain. On completion, exact GA_Air calls ftCo_80090780 when the flag is set or ftCo_Fall_Enter otherwise. Non-air values test x0 <= 0: true calls ftCo_80098160 with DownStandU only for DownDamageU and DownStandD otherwise; false calls ftCo_80097F38, which requests the corresponding DownWait motion. No clamp occurs. NaN takes the false comparison branch, which is therefore not equivalent to a positive countdown.
facts.rationale: Correct float boundary semantics and report exact routing.

facts.value: Obtains Fighter from gobj->user_data. Exact GA_Ground calls ft_80082708; its GA_Ground result forwards gobj to ftCo_8008FC94, which forwards Fighter to ftCommon_8007D5D4 and sets GA_Air. Another result calls ftCo_800C7CA0. For non-ground entry, true ft_80081DD4 forwards Fighter to ftCommon_8007D7FC; otherwise either wall-hug bit enables gobj forwarding to ftCo_800C1D38 and, only on false, ftCo_800C17CC.
facts.rationale: Replace incorrect grounded-handling interpretation with canonical call and field flow.

facts.value: For exact GA_Ground entry, GA_Ground from ft_80082708 triggers air setup through ftCo_8008FC94; another result attempts guarded DownReflect. For non-ground entry, true ft_80081DD4 invokes shared grounding; otherwise either wall-hug bit permits guarded PassiveWall/PassiveWallJump admission before ftCo_800C17CC. Successful first admission skips reflection. Ceiling-only contact does not reach this ladder, but its reflection helper can process ceiling reflection after wall reflection fails. Reflection guards include strict knockback thresholds and prior-surface checks.
facts.rationale: Preserve the surprising source branch and distinguish outer wall gating from the fallback's full behavior.

facts.value: Six DownBound/DownWait/DownDamage motions pass a flag-or-strict-damage guard before shared setup. Only incoming DownWaitU requests DownDamageU; others request DownDamageD, with a possible shared Ice override. Animation conditionally decrements a float before its completion guard, then routes by exact GA_Air, x2224_b2, and x0 <= 0 to canonical successor helpers. IASA is empty; physics delegates unconditionally. Collision routes a GA_Ground query result to air setup, the other grounded-path result to a DownReflect attempt, and non-ground processing to grounding or wall-recovery-before-reflection.
facts.rationale: Repair summary-level final-state and collision assumptions while preserving complete local behavior.
